items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: And it was also a part of his presentation, the music and all. You know? I like to — I’ve adopted some of that yeah.

ctx.x: I remember seeing Cannonball, I think I saw him live about three times. And that was a big part of what he did is that even before he played he had a welcoming delivery to the audience. He made you want to listen harder and sometimes gave you a little information about the tunes and so forth that I tried to remember as a worthwhile thing to do.

Yeah. He was like a preacher you know or a very astute professor. Yeah. What he had to say, and his voice, was one that he spoke so well. And it was also a part of his presentation, the music and all. You know? I like to — I’ve adopted some of that yeah. Sharing some information, a little storytelling, reflecting on some things that are going on on stage whether it’s between us and the audience, sure man, that’s connecting with an audience man is so important I believe. Some folks they just get up and start…
I was happy to see that you recorded [scats]
